# Popular Jana Neethi Medicals & Surgicals

> Popular Jana Neethi Medicals & Surgicals is a trusted healthcare retail network in Perinthalmanna and Angadippuram (Malappuram, Kerala) providing prescription & Jan Aushadhi generic medicines, surgical supplies, medical equipment, easy EMI equipment financing, home-care medical equipment rentals, and doorstep medicine delivery via WhatsApp.

## Core Services
- **Medicines & Jan Aushadhi Generics**: Prescription medications, chronic-care medicines, Pradhan Mantri Jan Aushadhi affordable generics, OTC essentials, vitamins, diabetes and cardiac care supplies.
- **Surgical Products**: Stainless steel surgical instruments, sterile gauze and dressings, nitrile/latex gloves, IV sets, syringes, catheters, orthopedic supports, and hospital consumables.
- **Medical Equipment**: Digital blood pressure monitors, pulse oximeters, nebulizers, glucometers, stethoscopes, thermometers, walkers, and clinical diagnostic devices.
- **EMI Shopping**: Easy monthly installment (EMI) plans for high-value medical devices including oxygen concentrators (5L/10L), CPAP/BiPAP machines, multi-parameter patient monitors, motorized hospital beds, and suction units.
- **Medical Equipment Rental**: Affordable daily, weekly, and monthly rentals of sanitized hospital beds (Fowler/Semi-Fowler), wheelchairs, oxygen concentrators and cylinders, BiPAP/CPAP machines, and air mattresses with home delivery and setup.
- **Home Delivery via WhatsApp**: Customers can send their prescription on WhatsApp to get genuine medicines and healthcare essentials delivered safely to their doorstep in and around Perinthalmanna and Angadippuram.

- **Where can I rent a hospital bed or oxygen concentrator in Perinthalmanna?**
  Popular Jana Neethi Medicals & Surgicals offers sanitized hospital beds, wheelchairs, oxygen concentrators, BiPAP/CPAP machines, and air mattresses on affordable daily, weekly, or monthly rental plans across Perinthalmanna and Angadippuram.
- **Does Popular Jana Neethi deliver medicines to home?**
  Yes. Send your prescription via WhatsApp to Popular Jana Neethi Medicals & Surgicals for fast, safe doorstep home delivery of medicines and surgical supplies.
- **Can I buy medical equipment on EMI in Perinthalmanna?**
  Yes. Popular Jana Neethi provides easy EMI options for oxygen concentrators, patient monitors, CPAP/BiPAP units, and motorized hospital beds.
